summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/tanstack-query-mobx@6.2.4 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB @bun/@bun-cjs bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotation function, hc1jfK9 character-map decoder, hex-keyed dispatch tables) whose content is unrelated to the advertised TanStack-Query/MobX React integration. Executing an obfuscated bundle via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall places attacker-defined code on the installer's machine outside the Node lifecycle and evades Node-based inspection. The package publishes under the @servicetitan scope with homepage/repository pointing at github.com/servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib, but the shipped preinstall dropper is inconsistent with a first-party ServiceTitan React utility and is consistent with a namespace-hijack or scope-squat publication.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
